report_peer_review.scope: Independent read-only peer QA of both complete round3 report templates against frozen aggregate manifests and already completed domain evidence; no new source investigation, tests, mutation runs or repository edits.

verified_claims.evidence: aggregate-review.json summary/files/declarations; current-test-declarations.json; baseline84.xml and baseline85.xml
verified_claims.judgment: Counts and denominators agree. Dataset cases are distinguished from declarations; assertion totals across repeated runs are not added.

verified_claims.topic: Every-test review versus actually executed TDD
verified_claims.judgment: The templates explicitly reject an individual executed RED claim for every existing test. Real tool bugs, semantic mutation witnesses and static PHPStan failures remain separate.
The numeric census matches the saved canonical records, including shared-control deduplication. Full-suite versus whole-file controls are qualified correctly.

ObjectPipeline generic ReflectionClass input is a static contract fix. assertShape removes the false @phpstan-assert, does not replace it with an accepted @param-out, retains runtime canonicalization and points to typed normalize(). The rejected param-out experiment, partial mutation on failure and future copying/reference ownership decision are represented faithfully. The English companion is shorter but does not contradict the detailed Russian plan.

verified_claims.evidence: parameters domain notes; aggregate-review.json survivors and excluded_or_superseded
verified_claims.judgment: The mixed-list addition is described as observed continuation/diagnostics, not an exploit or a current runtime defect. Cache/eligibility/proxy/shape additions test already-correct production behavior. The three alias-shape message-only mutant IDs have no accepted executed witness and remain excluded. Trait unused-fixture CI failure is attributed to the audit test, not original production. Original inline-decorator and pure-variadic variants are explicitly preserved in final proofs.

verified_claims.topic: Survivor conclusions are not bug counts
verified_claims.judgment: The stated 67 reasoned/unexecuted core candidates match the core reviewer records. They are distinct from this domain's 67 meaningful IDs, of which 19 have an accepted own-domain catalogue witness. Neither is presented as 67 confirmed production bugs.

verified_claims.evidence: aggregate-review.json current JUnit join, limits, excluded_or_superseded; domain harness review
verified_claims.judgment: Local skips are recorded separately. Native PHP85 fixtures explain PHP84 skips; the PHP85 contextual self union case is separately skipped. Timeout/setup/fixture failures are explicitly not semantic REDs. Engine outcomes are not treated as proof of an intended assertion.

All 53 referenced aggregate input hashes and all 1260 archive entries match actual saved files. Historical proof snapshots are not relabelled as final-head executions. The text does not mislabel the checkpoint-fddf029 AST as a 141feff AST. Mutable vendor/runtime/checkouts are not implied to be immutable archived source evidence.

No universal vulnerability absence, hostile-PHP sandbox, automatic Codex Security scan or performance-equivalence claim is made. Trusted application callbacks and exception-chain/side-effect limits are explicit. Smoke verification and benchmark statistic correction are not described as an application throughput gain.

verified_claims.evidence: aggregate survivor reachability verdicts; parameters precise-byref-typing-plan.md
verified_claims.judgment: Support decisions for low-level APIs remain decisions rather than unsupported declarations of dead code. Benefits, consumer compatibility, partial-state/reference semantics and measurement requirements are bounded. Native E1 remains feature-local and is not used to raise the component PHP requirement.

publication_conditions.details: Final CI/coverage/mutation placeholders are intentionally unresolved in the reviewed templates. The future-tense completion claims in RU13 and the final validation sections are acceptable only when root fills them from the actual final code-head run and verifies its result; this QA does not turn pending CI into GREEN.
Populate TDD_DECLARATIONS with37 from this frozen aggregate. Preserve separate engine timeout/completed-kill caveats when filling MUTATION_CAVEAT, and keep skips separate from passed counts.

limits: This is report consistency QA, not a fresh source/security audit and not a rerun of any source, test, static analyzer, native fixture, benchmark or CI job.
All report prose was read in full; large JSONs were reviewed structurally and through specific relevant records, not attested as a new line-by-line domain audit.

The truth of every other reviewer's semantic interpretation is not independently re-proved by matching hashes or counts. Root-owned global runtime-token equivalence, dependency audit, parity/benchmark gates and native E1 observations remain attributed to their saved evidence.
External PHPStan documentation links were not re-researched during this read-only QA.

The English text is explicitly an abbreviated companion; it need not repeat every Russian plan detail, including the nested-reference-slot acceptance note, provided the detailed report remains linked.
Only this scratch QA JSON was written. Repository code, tests, report templates, manifests and proofs were not modified.

limitations: Only 37 declarations have newly executed individual meaningful RED/GREEN; 725 have individual manual review and whole-suite validation.
The 552 baseline survivor decisions are distinct from the final engine outcome; 115 meaningful candidates remain reasoned/unexecuted.
Timeouts count in engine MSI but do not establish a semantic oracle.
Native E1 on available PHP 8.5.8 is 2/10 with unverified release/source provenance; feature-local only.
The required Codex Security server tool was unavailable; no automated Codex Security scan is claimed.
Absolute workspace paths are historical provenance, not portable commands without root substitution.
Archive preserves excluded attempts. Inclusion alone does not make a result canonical.
